## Primary Request and Intent
- User is developing the DSH plugin `dsh-whale-pal` at `D:\AI 项目\插件dsh-whale-pal开发` (v0.1.0, ESM), verified live in the `desktop` profile.
- "这是新会话，我已经重启关闭billion-context插件了" — new session; host restarted, billion-context plugin disabled.
- Earlier questions answered: compaction thresholds and plugin parameter meanings ("插件参数的定义我都不知道，所以以后涉及到这些尽量解释一下，不然我很难看懂" — always explain what a plugin parameter controls and how it computes).
- User corrected themselves twice: "弄错了，160K" (not 16K) and "我意思是这个插件的压缩阈值"; then dropped it: "算了，先看看还有哪些没做的".
- "行" → approved running `node scripts/verify.mjs`.
- "清理吧" → approved cleaning the 6 vault-root residue files.
- "命令成功回执口径是什么，我忘了" → explained; user replied "先放着".
- Latest instruction: "先放着，继续P3.5" — park the command-receipt item, resume P3.5 acceptance work.

## Key Technical Concepts
- DSH host compaction: plugin `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`; defaults `DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_RATIO = 0.8`, `DEFAULT_RETAIN_RATIO = 0.16`, `headroomTokens = 65536`; trigger = `floor(min(W × thresholdRatio, W − O − headroomTokens))`; retention keeps newest `retainRatio × (W − O)` verbatim; `retainRatio`/`retainTokens` mutually exclusive; load rejects retention ≥ threshold ratio.
- `llm-pi-ai` adapter fallbacks when a model declares no capacity: `DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW = 262144`, `DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 32768`; GUI capacity hint strings are "256K"/"32K".
- guiji route (SiliconFlow relay) declares no `contextWindow` → W = 262144, O = 32768 → effective trigger **163,840 tokens**; ratio path 209,715 unused. On a 1M window it would be `min(800000, 901696) = 800000` with retention ≈154.8K.
- whale-pal never compacts; `lib/ctx/threshold.js` only reminds: `remind {ratio 0.45, tokens 60000}`, `urge {0.2, 25000}`, `critical {0.1, 12000}`; hits when `remaining <= min(ratio × window, tokens)`. On the 256K window the remind tier (94.7K remaining) and on 1M (60K remaining) both fire *after* host compaction.
- Manual compaction command exists: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact`, slash command `/compact`, GUI description "压缩以上对话内容" — verified present in the live slash menu (`dsh-slash-option-command-*`, alias `compact`).
- whale-pal ctx archive: `sessionProjections.apply` is pure replay and must NOT write disk (only accumulate `pendingArchives`); landing happens at the next tool call or `/whale ctx sync`, then entries marked `written`. Anchoring block must contain no timestamps (prefix-cache stability). `_上下文/` is a derived cache rebuildable via `rebuildAll` from archives; only `lib/ctx/store.js` and `lib/upgrade/io.js` may touch disk (`lib/ctx/inject.js` additionally only `node:crypto`).

## Files and Code
- `C:\Users\123\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml` (145 lines): guiji provider block at lines 67–83 with `api: openai-completions`, `baseURL: https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1`, `compat: supportsDeveloperRole: false`, model `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` (no `contextWindow`); `agent-default-model` → provider `guiji`; nezhai's `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` declares `contextWindow: 1000000`; no `dsh-compaction-basic` override; billion-context no longer referenced.
- `C:\Users\123\.dsh\cordis.patch.yml`: 3 bytes, content `[]`, mtime Oct 29 — not the active config.
- `C:\Users\123\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`: deps still list `billion-context: 0.1.209`; `dsh.profile.bundles` list contains `dsh-whale-pal` (`link:D:/AI 项目/插件dsh-whale-pal开发`) and excludes billion-context.
- `docs/交接-2026-11-04.md` (61 lines): status, completed phases P1–P3.5, 待办池 (4 items), five invariants, common commands, pitfalls.
- `docs/P35-自检.md` (43 lines): ten acceptance items all test-backed; real machine only needed for the shape of a real `compaction` payload and whether `contextPressure` is immediately available; §四 lists two criteria still undefined at stage 6 (multi-block `summary` joining; possible momentary absence of `pressureTokens` right after compaction).
- `lib/ctx/threshold.js`: `LIMITS` and `remainingOf`/`tierOf`/`rank`/`shouldAnnounce`.
- `lib/ctx/source.js`: `pickSource` three-state native/occupied/none; native needs `pressureTokens` + `contextWindow`.
- Actual vault root `D:\AI 空间\记忆空间`: remaining entries `LICENSE`, `README.md`, `硅基助手_升级完成-V4.6-2026-11-04-0425.md`; `_上下文` directory still does not exist.
- Repo docs: `docs/P3-*.md`, `docs/P35-补全/拆解/自检/对照/串联.md`.
- No `.git` in the plugin directory (not a git repo).

## Errors and Fixes
- `ops_read_files` on `C:/Users/123/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` → `PATH_RESTRICTED` (junction/reparse in path); worked around with `sed`/`grep` via bash.
- `cd "D:/AI Agent/deepseek Harness/resources/app.asar/dsh"` → "Not a directory"; the real unpacked dir is `app.asar.unpacked/dsh` (contains only `node_modules`); DSH code lives inside `app.asar` and was read by scanning its bytes with Node.
- `node -e "readFileSync('/tmp/st.json')"` → `ENOENT 'D:\tmp\st.json'` (Git Bash `/tmp` ≠ Node `D:\tmp`); re-fetched status to a workspace-relative path.
- Host HTTP probes `/api/commands`, `/api/health`, etc. → `401`; used the GUI slash menu instead.
- Prior cold-start `400` on the first request of a new session: SiliconFlow rejects the `developer` role; fixed by `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false` (evidence: this session runs on guiji without 400).

## Pending Jobs
- P3.5 last two grids: after one *real* compaction — `/status.ctx.cards` 0→1, `_上下文/索引.md` gains one eight-column row, `锚定块.md` contains no date/time; plus the real-machine "卸妆" (makeup-off) check once the first archive exists.
- Stage-6 undefined criteria: multi-block `summary` joining boundary; whether `contextPressure` is momentarily missing right after compaction.
- Parked by the user: command-success receipt (m02951) — decide the form (session message / settings-page line / no receipt); user said "先放着".
- Not started: P4 节律台账, P5 迁移.
- Open question: whether guiji/SiliconFlow really supports a 1M window, i.e. whether to add `contextWindow: 1000000` to the guiji model block (user said "算了" for now).

## Current Work
- Resumed P3.5. Confirmed acceptance criteria and current state, and verified `/compact` is available in this GUI's slash-command menu.
- Cleanup completed: the 6 residue files were **moved** (not deleted) to `D:\AI 空间\助手备份\库根残渣_2026-11-04_0830` — `硅基助手_升级完成-V4.6-2026-11-04-0418.md`, `…-0421.md`, `LICENSE.bak-2026-11-03T20-21-55-588Z`, `LICENSE.bak-2026-11-03T20-25-31-586Z`, `README.md.bak-2026-11-03T20-21-55-593Z`, `README.md.bak-2026-11-03T20-25-31-592Z`; `/status` upgrade still resolves `0425`, `done: true`, health `normal`/`green`; scratch `st.json`/`st2.json` removed from the repo.
- Verification passed: `node scripts/verify.mjs` → syntax 52 files, import `name=dsh-whale-pal inject=systemPrompt,webServer,commands,tools`, tests **716 pass / 0 fail (55 files)**.
- Live host (port 54740): health `normal`/`green`, `selftest` "首次启动，没有上次退出记录", `mounted = routes 1 · commands 1 · tools 7 · sections 2`; ctx `ready: true, cards: 0, lastId: "", anchor: false`.
- Current session usage from the session store: last `usage` `{inputTokens: 771, outputTokens: 668, totalTokens: 69279, cacheReadTokens: 67840}`; first turn `inputTokens: 29941` + `1920` cache ≈ 32K fixed overhead (system prompt + tools) — far above any 16K target.
- A browser tab was opened at `http://127.0.0.1:54740`, "/" typed into a fresh-session composer to reveal the command menu, then the tab was closed; nothing was submitted.

## Next Step
- Ask the user to type `/compact` once in this session, then call `whale_ctx` with `action: sync` to force landing and check `/status.ctx.cards`, `_上下文/索引.md`, and `锚定块.md` (no date/time).

## Critical Context
- Approval policy is "never"; do not request sandbox escalation. Working dir is `D:\AI 项目\插件dsh-whale-pal开发`; DSH checkout is inside `D:\AI Agent\deepseek Harness\resources\app.asar` (read via byte scanning, `app.asar.unpacked/dsh` holds only `node_modules`).
- Plugin code changes require a host restart (`link:` junction); persist user preference: explain each plugin parameter (what it controls, how it is computed) before using it, and always take a manual snapshot before config changes.
- The user prefers moving files to a backup folder over deletion; destruction of vault content needs explicit approval; the real vault must not be overwritten without an explicit go-ahead.
- Model changed mid-session from `guiji/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` to `a77625/x-deepseek-v4.1-flash`.
- Working scrub procedure that proved useful: decompress session stores via `node -e` + `zlib.zstdDecompressSync`, extract only needed fields; never read the whole `/status` (71 KB) into context.
- m02951 = the user's message index in the old archived session (`session-8e811f83-22aa-496b-a497-3900a734e04f`, decodes ~45 MB) where the receipt item was frozen; that session is archive-only (host compaction on it returns 400 `20015 messages is invalid`).
- Persona/config live state: name 六一, selfName empty, title "用户"; whale-pal data root `~/.dsh/whale-pal/desktop` with `audit.jsonl` tracking open topics.
